job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic frame from a cinematic street interview at night. A Russian man about 38 with short dark hair, a neat dark stubble beard, tired serious eyes, an olive-green linen overshirt over a dark t-shirt. He sits at an outdoor table of a quiet night cafe, looking slightly to the right of the camera at an interlocutor, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, serious and emotional, NO smile. Medium close-up from the chest up, both shoulders inside the frame, face large and sharp, top of head about 12% below the upper edge. Background: night city street with warm orange street lamps, green trees and soft bokeh lights, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end cinema camera, teal-and-orange night grading but natural skin, NOT CGI. No text, no logos, no watermark.
